messages:
Avery: Thanks everyone for joining today — leaving an open thread for any follow-ups from the all-hands about mission, positioning, roadmap, or competitors. I'll answer live and Sam/Riya/Lee will jump in. Drop short questions here.

Jordan: Quick one — how are we prioritizing Dedicated vs Private for sales ops? Are we pushing enterprise-first for Private or trying to upsell Dedicated first?

Sam: Good q. Short answer: Dedicated = our primary growth motion for mid-market/high-usage customers (predictable throughput + cost). Private is enterprise-only for regulated workloads where customers need VPC/HSM/KMS and an on-prem option. We qualify on compliance + committed spend.

Riya: Following up on mission wording — is our public mission still "make high-performance, reliable LLM inference accessible to every engineering team" or are we shifting language toward "inference economics"?

Avery: Mission stays developer-first. We are leaning into the economics framing in go-to-market materials (helps with procurement conversations), but the core promise to engineers is predictable performance and easy integration. So both messages co-exist depending on audience.

Lee: Positioning vs managed cloud endpoints vs pure self-hosted runtimes — what’s the elevator pitch we should use in RFPs?

Sam: Elevator pitch: "We provide a single runtime and operational layer so you get the performance & controls of self-hosting without the ops burden — plus clear, measurable cost levers (batching, caching, quant profiles) and SLAs." Emphasize rollouts + per-route observability as an ops differentiator.

Marta: Do we have benchmark artifacts we can point prospects to (latency/cost comparisons)?

Avery: Yes — internal perf pack is ready. External benchmark blog is Q2. For now, share the internal deck (PMs/SEs get access). We'll publish a sanitized benchmark with methodology when legal signs off.

Jordan: Roadmap follow-up: console priorities — where do tracing/per-route dashboards sit?

Riya: Tracing alpha = end of Q2 (internal), public beta Q3. Per-route cost & token breakdowns = Q3. We’re accelerating based on sales signals.

Jordan: Great — any temporary workarounds we should use for demos?

Sam: For demos, use the per-request logging + sample prefix-caching config. Quick snippet to show fallback policy in a demo:

```json
{"route": "prod-chat", "fallback": ["redwood-small", "redwood-micro"], "latency_slo_ms": 150}
```

Lee: Competitor note — expect cloud providers to push cheaper GPUs. Our play: lean into SLA/latency, integrated ops, and predictable economics rather than raw price. Also highlight private deployment + compliance features.

Marta: Any changes to packaging/pricing for Dedicated?

Avery: No immediate changes. We're introducing clearer committed tiers and better autoscaling burst options. Finance + Pricing team will publish an FAQ next week.

Jordan: Thanks — this helps.

Sam: If you need collateral for conversations, ping me or @Riya; we'll fast-track slides for immediate prospects. :thumbsup:

Avery: Appreciate the questions. Keep them coming here or DM if sensitive. Closing the live thread soon but we'll keep monitoring. :sparkles:
